text:
incidents-bot: PAGING: Elevated 429s from GPU hotpath pool in us-west-2. Aggregate 429 rate ~18% across frontdoor, queue growth on inference-service. Root TS 2365001234. See control-plane link: https://console.redwood/ops/incidents/2365001234 :rotating_light:
Alex K: oncall pinged, grabbing the thread.
Nisha P: I'm oncall. I see queue length ~28k and tail latency spikes to 30s. Autoscaler isn't bringing the pool under target.
Matt R: Autoscaler logs showing repeated scale attempts but capped by max_instances and quota errors. snippet:
```
autoscaler ERROR: failed to spawn node: quotaExceeded (project quota gpu-spot us-west-2)
scale_loop INFO: pool=hotpath current=40 target=58 max=40 backoff=120s
ratelimiter WARN: tokenbucket reject_count=18234 burst_tok=18
```
Leo T: Noted — last config deploy night before lowered tokenbucket refill for tier `standard` (PR #4567) and disabled `tier.backfill=false`. That reduces overflow routing.
Sara O: Customer impact: CS dash shows ~5% of requests for customer AcmeCorp are getting 429s or degraded responses. CS already opened ticket and sent initial advisory.
Alex K: Mitigation plan (quick): 1) temporarily raise hotpath pool max_instances 2) enable tier backfill so overflow routes to warm pools 3) bump tokenbucket refill for `standard` tier. Doing step 1 now.
Nisha P: Running infra command to increase max_instances:
```
infra autoscaler update --pool hotpath --max-instances 80 --reason "incident 2365001234"
```
incidents-bot: infra request received, op_id=7890.
deploy-bot: autoscaler config apply op_id=7890 -> max_instances=80 :white_check_mark:
Matt R: Control plane shows +18 instances requested, nodes provisioning. ETA ~90s.
Leo T: Enabling tier backfill to allow overflow to warm pool:
```
infra config set tier.backfill true --env production --reason "incident 2365001234"
```
Alex K: Also applying temporary rate change for standard tier:
```
infra ratelimit modify --tier standard --refill-per-sec 1200 --burst 2400 --reason "incident 2365001234"
```
Nisha P: After the above changes, 429 rate reduced from 18% -> 3% within 2 minutes, queue draining to ~6k and falling. Monitoring closely.
Customer Support Bot: Notifying affected customers using template: "We detected elevated errors affecting inference. Mitigation in progress. Support ticket ID CS-7689"
Sara O: Planning: escalate to quota team to get permanent increase or carve a reserved pool. Filing postmortem ticket and assigning owners.
Alex K: Handoff plan: I'll hand to Leo in 30m for watch. Leaving note: we changed max_instances and turned on backfill and bumped tokenbucket refill. Watch for node churn and cost.
Leo T: Taking watch. I'll coordinate with infra-ops on quota and follow up on PR revert for the tokenbucket change.
Matt R: Root cause initial summary: three factors aligned — (1) tokenbucket refill lowered in recent deploy, (2) tier.backfill disabled so overflow couldn't move to warm pools, (3) autoscaler hard cap (`max_instances=40`) prevented scaling under sustained burst. Combination produced sustained saturation and unhandled queue growth -> 429s.
Nisha P: Post-incident action items: - revert tokenbucket change or make it traffic-aware; - re-enable backfill in config tests; - add autoscaler-canary to alert if pool stays >90% for >2m; - request quota bump or reserved GPU for hotpath.
Sara O: CS to reach out to known Tier-1 customers with a follow-up once we have root cause + ETA for permanent fixes.
incidents-bot: Incident status updated: MITIGATED -> MONITORING. All hands to watch for 60m. Last update 2365001540. :white_check_mark:
